title: Session Customizations
intro:
Round 2 compares the original Session Customizations direction with a refinement based on initial Slack feedback.

Both options separate the scoped **Session Customizations** right sidebar from the global **Customizations** modal. The refinement removes explicit session-scope pickers, combines MCP Servers and Connectors, introduces collapsible high-value sections, and aligns the sidebar treatment more closely with the Sessions list.

Please compare the two options rather than focusing on intentionally omitted customization detail-page content.
questions: Which option makes the session-scoped nature of the right sidebar clearer, and why?
Does combining MCP Servers and Connectors reduce terminology without losing useful meaning?
Do collapsible Plugins and MCP Servers sections improve scanability, or add unnecessary interaction?
Does the refined typography, spacing, and density feel more consistent with the Sessions list?

items.label: Original direction
items.note: V12 keeps explicit session scope pickers and separate Plugins, MCP Servers, and Connectors sections.

items.label: Feedback refinement
items.note: V13 inherits the active session scope, combines MCP Servers and Connectors, and uses collapsible sections with Sessions-list-aligned styling.
